title: Fix Reports subtab clicks
summary: Fixed Reports subtab click binding so Failures, Audit, and Locations tabs stay interactive even when Reports tab panes are normalized or temporarily not found during initialization.
reason: The Reports tab initializer returned before binding click handlers when pane discovery failed, leaving the visible subtabs inert.
behavior_before: Reports subtab event binding depended on finding direct-child Reports tab panes before attaching button click handlers.
behavior_after: Reports subtab buttons are bound as soon as the buttons exist, and pane activation uses a normalized direct-child helper instead of the fragile :scope selector.
manual_validation: Focused temporary browser smoke for Reports subtab clicks -> OK: Audit, Locations, and Failures each became aria-selected=true with one visible active panel

$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'; .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke -q -> FAILED on pre-existing text expectation: failure-rows missing 'Needs operator'; focused Reports tab click smoke passed
rollback_plan: Revert apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/reports/shell.js, tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py, the refreshed generated summaries, and this change packet; rerun Reports static and focused browser tab-click validation.
